description: This file defines a class 'ADODB_Compress_Bzip2' for managing Bzip2 compression within the ADOdb PHP library, including methods to set compression parameters and perform compression/decompression.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Bzip2
classes.description: A class encapsulating Bzip2 compression and decompression logic with configurable parameters.

methods.name: getBlockSize
methods.description: Returns the current block size used for compression.

methods.name: setBlockSize
methods.description: Sets the block size parameter for compression, with assertions to enforce valid range.

methods.name: getWorkLevel
methods.description: Returns the current work level parameter.

methods.name: setWorkLevel
methods.description: Sets the work level parameter, with assertions to enforce valid range.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum length of data to be compressed.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum length of data for compression.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize compression parameters with optional values.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses data if it meets the minimum length, using configured parameters.
